configuration.quotient_scale_selection_rule: match the quotient byte scale to the measured counter's documented native accounting unit

counter_definitions.dram__bytes_read.sum: Nsight Compute DRAM read volume in bytes
counter_definitions.first_level_memory_accesses: analysis field backed by l1tex__t_sectors_pipe_lsu_mem_global_op_ld.sum; native unit is one 32-byte global-load L1TEX sector
counter_definitions.gpu__time_duration.sum: Nsight Compute kernel duration in nanoseconds
counter_definitions.l1tex__t_requests_pipe_lsu_mem_global_op: Nsight Compute sum of L1TEX requests generated by global load instructions
counter_definitions.l1tex__t_sectors_pipe_lsu_mem_global_op_: Nsight Compute sum of 32-byte L1TEX sectors requested by global load instructions
counter_definitions.lts__t_sectors_op_read_lookup_miss.sum: Nsight Compute sum of read sectors that miss the L2 lookup
counter_definitions.lts__t_sectors_srcunit_tex_op_read.sum: Nsight Compute sum of read sectors presented to L2 by TEX source units; used for both L1-to-L2 read traffic and L2 read work
counter_definitions.sectors_per_request: derived coalescing measure: global-load L1TEX sectors divided by global-load L1TEX requests

measurement_scope.aggregation: median of the final target launches within a profiler process, then median across independent launches
measurement_scope.hardware: whole-kernel NVIDIA first-level, L2, and DRAM read-work counters
measurement_scope.process_isolation: one ncu invocation per mapping and launch

panel.selection: minimum full address-expression runs, then stable canonical word
